verdict.rationale: BugSnag's Data Access API is published as a versioned OpenAPI 3.0.3 document on SwaggerHub (version path "/2"), and the developer portal lists a dedicated "Versioning" page, so versioned APIs are evidenced. Nothing in the pack describes deprecation timelines, sunset notices or a support-window policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset/migration process), the actual content of the versioning scheme, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
